name: 手机实测记录
description: 记录充电、睡前待机、游戏发热等真实使用测试，持续采样电量、温度、电压、电流和内存变化，生成适合酷安分享的曲线报告与对比结论。
description_en: Record real usage tests such as charging, overnight standby, and gaming heat, then generate Coolapk-style curve reports and comparison conclusions.

apis.name: startTestSession
apis.desc: 开始一次充电/待机/游戏记录，返回 sessionId
apis.desc_en: Start a charging/standby/game test session and return sessionId
paramDesc: 测试名称，例如 原装充电器、王者荣耀 20 分钟
备注，可记录充电器、数据线、散热条件等
paramDesc_en: Test label, e.g. original charger or 20 min gaming

apis.name: recordSample
apis.desc: 给指定测试追加一次采样；可由条件任务每 5 秒/1 分钟重复调用
apis.desc_en: Append one sample to a test session; can be repeated by scheduled tasks

apis.name: finishTestReport
apis.desc: 结束测试并生成充电曲线、待机耗电或游戏发热稳定性报告
apis.desc_en: Finish a session and generate a charging, standby, or gaming thermal report

apis.name: compareTestReports
apis.desc: 对比两次测试，突出峰值温度、电量变化、充电速度或发热稳定性差异
apis.desc_en: Compare two test reports by temperature, battery delta, charging speed, or stability

apis.name: listTestReports
apis.desc: 列出历史测试，支持充电器对比、连续待机复测和游戏复测
apis.desc_en: List historical test sessions for comparison and retesting
